kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
أرتشف (form VIII)
# أَرْتَشِفُ (ʔartašifu) /ʔar.ta.ʃi.fu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِرْتَشَفَ (irtašafa)
# أُرْتَشَفُ (ʔurtašafu) /ʔur.ta.ʃa.fu/: first-person singular non-past passive indicative of اِرْتَشَفَ (irtašafa)
# أَرْتَشِفَ (ʔartašifa) /ʔar.ta.ʃi.fa/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِرْتَشَفَ (irtašafa)
# أُرْتَشَفَ (ʔurtašafa) /ʔur.ta.ʃa
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
